full_judgment: 2. The plaintiffs' cases was that the suit land measuring 8.11 appertains to a holding which totally comprised of 8.34 lands. The plaintiffs' predecessor Baharuddin purchased 4.24 lands by a registered kabala dated 18.1.27 from Hasiruddni and 2 others and also acquired the remaining 4.10 lands of the holding by exchange from Baharullah by a deed of exchange dated 22.2.28. Since then he was in rightful possession and upon his death the plaintiffs as his legal heirs have been in rightful possession of the said land out of which only 20 lands were allowed to be possessed by defendant 8 and 9 as licences. The suit land measuring 8.11 bears the exclusive right and possession of the plaintiffs for long over 12 years adversely to all others including the defendants. The plaintiffs have paid rents all through and their right have been record in the S.A. Khatian. The defendants No. 8 filed objection and appeal against the S.A. Record without any success. The defendants having threatened to disposes the plaintiffs on 8.11.74 they brought the suit.
